results.name: Forest Loner Diorama (PBR)
results.description:
A detailed PBR diorama scene depicting a lonely forest at night, softly illuminated by a bonfire beside a calm pond. This environment blends mystery and tranquility, enhanced with subtle animations and realistic visual effects — perfect for cinematic renders, lighting tests, or game environments.

The scene features two animated waterfalls, gentle ripples on the pond’s surface, and falling water effects for natural realism. Around the site, you’ll find an old wooden house, stone rocks, two caves (one hidden behind the waterfall), bamboo trees, jungle foliage, and scattered grass patches that complete the nocturnal forest atmosphere. A bonfire, a small barbecue, and drifting smoke create a warm contrast against the dark sky filled with stars.

The waterfall animation is adapted from Elin’s model: Looping Waterfall Bones Animation – Elin.

Enjoy exploring this peaceful yet mysterious world. If you like this scene, please leave a like and follow me for more cinematic dioramas and creative 3D environments..
